dict.string: Notchy shows your upcoming events in the notch. It only reads your calendars and never creates, edits or deletes events.
Notchy shows your upcoming events in the notch. It only reads your calendars and never creates, edits or deletes events.
When you turn on Reminders sync, Notchy keeps your tasks in sync with Apple Reminders so they reach your iPhone and Apple Watch.

Notchy transcribes your voice on-device to capture tasks and notes.
Notchy uses the microphone only while you dictate a task or note.
When you turn on Apple Notes sync, Notchy keeps your daily notes in a "Notchy" folder in Notes. It never touches your other notes.
